info.longName: iShares International Developed Real Estate ETF

funds_data.description: The fund seeks to track the investment results of the FTSE EPRA Nareit Developed ex U.S. Index (the “underlying index”), which measures the performance of companies engaged in the ownership, trading and development of income-producing real estate in the developed real estate markets (except for the U.S.) as defined by FTSE EPRA Nareit.
